description: PROVISIONAL PLACEHOLDER (23-10-2026). The 2015 Airservices table lists the modes and their runways but gives no preference order, so every mode has the same preference by day; the order of the modes is NOT a ranking. By night (the curfew period) Mode 1 is preferred and the other modes carry a higher penalty rather than being forbidden, so a wet night with no usable curfew mode still gives an answer. Replace with the current operating plan (LTOP) when it is supplied.
